name: ai-governance-refresh
title: AI Governance Refresh
use_when: The city wants an annual refresh of acceptable-use, review, and oversight practices for AI.
output: A policy refresh memo, training priorities, and implementation checklist.

name: annual-report
title: Annual Report
use_when: The city wants a public annual report that explains results, finances, and priorities to residents in plain language.
output: A resident-friendly annual report outline and draft text with accessible charts guidance, plus a fact-check table linking each claim to a source.

name: audit-response
title: Audit Response
use_when: The city needs to respond to audit findings, comments, or management recommendations.
output: A response memo with corrective actions, owners, dates, and communication language.

name: budget-adoption-book
title: Budget Adoption Book
use_when: You need a polished summary for workshops or adoption.
output: An adoption-ready summary book with narrative, highlights, trade-offs, and public-facing explanations.

name: budget-kickoff
title: Budget Kickoff
use_when: The city is opening its annual budget cycle and needs clear instructions and framing.
output: A budget kickoff memo, calendar, department instructions, and key assumptions.

name: comprehensive-plan-update
title: Comprehensive Plan Update
use_when: The city is initiating, managing, or tracking a periodic update to its comprehensive land use plan and needs to organize the process, communicate with the community, and ensure consistency across plan elements.
output: A project overview memo with scope, timeline, public engagement milestones, state compliance checklist, inter-element consistency notes, and a list of policy questions requiring council direction.

name: goal-setting-retreat
title: Goal Setting Retreat
use_when: The council or executive team is preparing for its annual retreat or planning session.
output: A retreat packet with briefing memo, agenda, facilitation prompts, and draft goal language.

name: legislative-agenda
title: Legislative Agenda
use_when: The city is setting its annual policy and advocacy priorities with outside governments.
output: A concise legislative agenda with talking points and priority tiers.

name: state-of-the-city
title: State of the City
use_when: The mayor or manager needs an annual community narrative.
output: A speech or report that balances celebration, honesty, and the year ahead.

name: sustainability-and-resilience-review
title: Sustainability and Resilience Review
use_when: The city is reviewing its sustainability, energy, climate-adaptation, and resilience work against adopted goals and emerging hazards.
output: A review memo with progress against goals, vulnerability priorities, funded versus unfunded actions, and recommended next-year initiatives.

name: technology-governance-review
title: Technology and AI Governance Review
use_when: The city needs to conduct an annual review of its technology systems, cybersecurity posture, data governance practices, and AI use — assessing risk, policy alignment, and readiness for the year ahead.
output: A technology governance review memo with systems risk summary, cybersecurity posture assessment, AI use inventory and policy gaps, compliance status, and recommended council action items.

name: constituent-response
title: Constituent Response
use_when: You need a calm, useful response to a resident complaint, question, compliment, or service request.
output: A reply draft, internal escalation note, and any follow-up questions or promises to avoid.

name: councilmember-daily-brief
title: Councilmember Daily Brief
use_when: A councilmember needs a concise update on hot issues, resident concerns, and upcoming decision points.
output: A compact daily memo grouped into watch items, resident issues, decisions ahead, and suggested follow-up.

name: difficult-email
title: Difficult Email Response
use_when: You need to respond to an angry, accusatory, or politically sensitive email without escalating conflict.
output: A measured response draft plus a shorter alternative and internal risk notes.

name: executive-brief
title: Executive Brief
use_when: You need a one-page briefing for the mayor, city manager, or council on a fast-moving issue.
output: A short executive brief with issue, background, options, recommendation, risks, and next steps.

name: inbox-prioritizer
title: Inbox Prioritizer
use_when: An elected or executive office needs help sorting email into action buckets.
output: A prioritized list grouped into respond, delegate, watch, schedule, and archive.

name: media-talking-points
title: Media Talking Points
use_when: A leader or spokesperson needs concise public-facing talking points for media or stakeholder calls.
output: Core messages, quotable language, do-not-say notes, and likely Q&A.

name: meeting-prep
title: Meeting Prep
use_when: You need talking points, questions, and motion pathways before a council or board meeting.
output: Item-by-item prep notes, likely questions, possible motions, and risk flags.

name: public-records-response
title: Public Records / FOIA Response
use_when: You have received a public records or FOIA request and need to triage it, identify responsive records and custodians, apply any applicable exemptions, and draft a timely written response.
output: A triage summary with responsive-records inventory, exemption analysis, draft response letter, and internal checklist for meeting the legal deadline.

name: quick-policy-explainer
title: Quick Policy Explainer
use_when: You need to explain a city policy, ordinance, process, or decision in plain English.
output: A plain-language explanation, FAQ bullets, and one-paragraph public summary.

name: service-request-triage
title: Service Request Triage
use_when: The city needs to route resident or internal service requests quickly and consistently.
output: A triage summary with owner, urgency, service category, resident-facing response, and escalation need.

name: campaign-to-governance-boundary
title: Campaign to Governance Boundary
use_when: A candidate or officeholder needs help respecting the line between campaigning and official acts.
output: A boundary memo noting what is safe, risky, or requires legal/policy review.

name: candidate-briefing
title: Candidate Briefing
use_when: The city wants a neutral, educational briefing for candidates or prospective candidates.
output: A neutral briefing deck or memo explaining roles, process, and major city issues.

name: first-100-days-plan
title: First 100 Days Plan
use_when: A newly elected mayor, councilmember, or new city manager needs a realistic plan for listening, learning, building relationships, and securing early wins in the first 100 days.
output: A 100-day plan with listening tour, learning agenda, relationship map, early wins, communication rhythm, and a list of decisions to avoid or defer.

name: new-council-onboarding
title: New Council Onboarding
use_when: The city is onboarding one or more newly elected councilmembers.
output: An onboarding plan, reading list, and first-meeting prep packet.

name: transition-memo
title: Transition Memo
use_when: A newly elected official or incoming administration needs a handoff packet.
output: A transition memo organized into first 30/90/180 day issues and key decisions ahead.

name: after-action-review
title: After Action Review
use_when: The city is wrapping an incident and wants structured learning rather than blame.
output: An after-action report with observations, corrective actions, owners, and deadlines.

name: crisis-comms
title: Crisis Communications
use_when: The city must communicate during a high-stakes operational or reputational incident.
output: A message house, holding statement, FAQs, and update cadence.

name: cyber-incident-response
title: Cyber Incident Response Brief
use_when: The city has a suspected or confirmed cyber incident (ransomware, account compromise, data exposure, or service disruption) and leadership needs a coordinated brief covering operations, notification, and communications.
output: An incident brief with containment status, decision list, notification checklist, continuity plan, and holding statements, with no technical detail that would aid an attacker.

name: damage-assessment-and-reimbursement
title: Damage Assessment and Disaster Reimbursement Tracker
use_when: After a disaster the city must document damage, track costs, and prepare for state or federal reimbursement and needs a structured, audit-ready approach.
output: A damage inventory, cost-documentation checklist, reimbursement timeline, and gaps list ready for the finance director and emergency manager.

name: emergency-proclamation
title: Emergency Proclamation
use_when: The city is considering or preparing an emergency declaration or supporting order.
output: A draft proclamation plus a legal/process checklist and public explanation.

name: eoc-activation-brief
title: Emergency Operations Center Activation Brief
use_when: The emergency manager or city manager is deciding whether to activate, escalate, or stand down the emergency operations center (EOC) and needs a clear brief for the operational period.
output: An activation recommendation, operational period objectives, staffing and resource plan, decision log template, and leadership briefing script.

name: incident-brief
title: Incident Brief
use_when: You need a rapid, leader-ready summary during an incident.
output: A situation report with facts, impacts, actions underway, asks, and message guidance.

name: public-health-emergency
title: Public Health Emergency Response
use_when: The city is responding to a disease outbreak, water quality failure, mass casualty event, or other public health emergency requiring coordinated city action alongside the county or state health authority.
output: A city role summary, inter-agency coordination checklist, public messaging draft, resource deployment list, and a timeline of required notifications and actions.

name: shelter-and-recovery
title: Shelter and Recovery Support
use_when: The city needs resident-facing guidance for shelter, donations, debris, cleanup, or support services.
output: Resident guidance in plain English plus internal coordination notes.

name: tornado-recovery
title: Tornado Recovery
use_when: The city needs structured recovery planning after severe weather or tornado impacts.
output: A recovery action plan with immediate, near-term, and long-term tasks.

name: utility-failure-response
title: Utility Failure Response
use_when: The city is managing an extended failure of a water, wastewater, stormwater, electric, or gas utility system and needs to coordinate operations, public communications, mutual aid, and regulatory notifications.
output: An incident coordination brief with operational priorities, regulatory notification checklist, public communications draft, vulnerable-population action items, and an escalation decision tree.

name: arpa-iija-grant-closeout
title: ARPA and IIJA Grant Closeout
use_when: The city is closing out or reporting on pandemic-recovery or infrastructure-law funded projects and must make sure obligations, expenditures, reporting, and records meet award terms before deadlines.
output: A closeout readiness memo with deadline calendar, reconciliation, compliance gaps, and a list of decisions about reallocating or returning unspent funds.

name: council-of-governments-brief
title: Council of Governments / MPO Meeting Brief
use_when: The mayor, manager, or council member needs to prepare for a regional council of governments (COG) or metropolitan planning organization (MPO) meeting — understanding the agenda, the city's positions, and the likely positions of other member governments.
output: A pre-meeting brief with item-by-item analysis, recommended city positions, anticipated allies and opponents, talking points for the city's representative, and any required council authorization.

name: federal-funding-coordination
title: Federal Funding Coordination
use_when: The city is pursuing, managing, or reporting on a federal grant or infrastructure funding opportunity and must coordinate with a state pass-through agency, federal program office, or congressional delegation.
output: A federal funding coordination brief with status summary, compliance obligation checklist, upcoming milestone calendar, intergovernmental communication plan, and a list of open issues requiring resolution.

name: state-legislative-testimony
title: State Legislative Testimony
use_when: The city needs to prepare written or oral testimony on state legislation that would affect municipal authority, revenue, services, or operations — either in support, opposition, or with requested amendments.
output: A testimony draft (written and/or oral summary), a fiscal and operational impact analysis, recommended amendments if the city seeks modifications, and a list of supporting municipalities or stakeholders.

name: bid-evaluation
title: Bid Evaluation
use_when: You need a documented, fair comparison of bids, proposals, or quotes.
output: An evaluation memo and comparison matrix with recommendation and caveats.

name: contract-approval-memo
title: Contract Approval Memo
use_when: A contract is moving to council or executive approval.
output: An approval memo summarizing scope, cost, procurement path, key terms, and review status.

name: grant-application-narrative
title: Grant Application Narrative
use_when: The city needs to draft the narrative section of a competitive grant application, including the statement of need, project description, goals and objectives, and evaluation approach.
output: A complete narrative draft aligned to the funder's evaluation criteria, an internal gap-and-weakness analysis, and a list of missing data points that must be confirmed before submission.

name: interlocal-agreement
title: Interlocal Agreement Review
use_when: The city is evaluating or drafting an interlocal or cooperative agreement.
output: A review memo plus revision suggestions and approval checklist.

name: ordinance-draft
title: Ordinance Draft
use_when: You need to draft or revise an ordinance.
output: A draft ordinance with purpose, operative language, procedural notes, and issue flags.

name: resolution-draft
title: Resolution Draft
use_when: You need a resolution for appointments, policy statements, approvals, or formal findings.
output: A clean draft resolution with recitals and action language.

name: rfp-scope
title: RFP Scope of Work
use_when: The city needs a clear solicitation scope for services or products.
output: A scope of work plus evaluation criteria and vendor question list.

name: sole-source-justification
title: Sole-Source Procurement Justification
use_when: The city intends to award a contract without competitive bidding and must document the legal basis and factual rationale for a sole-source or emergency procurement.
output: A complete sole-source justification memorandum suitable for the procurement file and council packet, plus a legal-basis checklist and a list of information gaps to resolve before signing.

name: agenda-cycle
title: Agenda Cycle
use_when: The city is building a regular or special meeting agenda packet.
output: A draft agenda order, packet checklist, missing items list, and item-by-item readiness status.

name: board-commission-appointments
title: Board & Commission Appointments
use_when: The city is filling vacancies or preparing appointment action for boards or commissions.
output: An appointment memo, eligibility screen, interview questions, and draft action language.

name: budget-amendment-memo
title: Budget Amendment Memo
use_when: A department or the finance office needs council approval to amend the adopted budget (transfer, supplemental appropriation, or reallocation) and needs a clear, compliant memo.
output: An amendment memo with fiscal effect, legal authority, alternatives, and draft council action language.

name: communications-calendar
title: Communications Calendar
use_when: The city needs a proactive monthly communication plan tied to projects, meetings, and events.
output: A channel-by-channel monthly communications calendar with message themes and owner assignments.

name: financial-review
title: Monthly Financial Review
use_when: Leadership needs a monthly look at revenues, expenditures, variances, cash, and claims.
output: A monthly finance memo explaining trendlines, outliers, and actions needed.

name: grant-pipeline-review
title: Grant Pipeline Review
use_when: The city wants a monthly snapshot of grants pursued, awarded, at-risk, or worth pursuing.
output: A pipeline review with next applications, compliance deadlines, award risks, and decisions needed.

name: performance-memo
title: Monthly Performance Memo
use_when: Leadership wants a monthly performance narrative across service areas.
output: A short memo explaining what moved, why it moved, and what management is doing next.

name: staff-report
title: Staff Report Builder
use_when: You need a clean, decision-ready staff report for council, a board, or a commission.
output: A staff report with summary, background, analysis, options, recommendation, attachments, and action language.

name: utility-rate-watch
title: Utility Rate Watch
use_when: Utility leadership or council needs a recurring rate and system pressure scan.
output: A rate watch memo with pressures, scenarios, timing options, and customer communication needs.

name: disciplinary-memo
title: Disciplinary Memo
use_when: You need a memo for corrective action or discipline.
output: A professional, factual memo with expectations and next steps.

name: hiring-scorecard
title: Hiring Scorecard
use_when: The city needs a structured interview and evaluation tool for hiring.
output: A scorecard, question set, and interview packet.

name: performance-evaluation
title: Performance Evaluation
use_when: A supervisor needs help drafting a balanced, specific evaluation.
output: A performance review draft with strengths, opportunities, and development goals.

name: religious-accommodation-response
title: Religious Accommodation Response
use_when: The city needs to respond to a religious accommodation request from an employee or elected official.
output: A response letter or memo that confirms the accommodation, identifies an alternative, or — only if accommodation is genuinely not feasible — documents the specific undue hardship finding with concrete facts.

name: workforce-reorganization
title: Workforce Reorganization
use_when: The city is considering reporting-line, staffing, or organizational redesign.
output: An options memo with org alternatives, pros/cons, and implementation issues.

name: community-faq
title: Community FAQ Builder
use_when: Residents keep asking the same questions and the city needs a public FAQ.
output: A public-facing FAQ with plain-language answers and pointers to source documents or contacts.

name: equity-impact-analysis
title: Equity Impact Analysis
use_when: Staff or elected officials want to understand how a proposed policy, budget item, project, or service change affects different neighborhoods and groups before a decision is made.
output: An equity impact memo with affected-population analysis, evidence and data gaps, mitigation options, and monitoring measures.

name: language-access-and-inclusive-outreach-plan
title: Language Access and Inclusive Outreach Plan
use_when: The city is planning outreach for a project, emergency, or service change and needs to reach residents who speak other languages, have disabilities, lack internet access, or are otherwise hard to reach.
output: An outreach plan with audience segments, channels, translation and accessibility actions, partner roles, budget, and measures of reach.

name: public-comment-synthesis
title: Public Comment Synthesis
use_when: You need to summarize public comment from hearings, meetings, or written submissions.
output: A theme-based synthesis with representative points, misconceptions, and response options.

name: survey-summary
title: Survey Summary
use_when: The city wants a readable synthesis of resident survey results.
output: A summary with toplines, notable splits, open-ended themes, and suggested next steps.

name: town-hall-briefing
title: Town Hall Briefing
use_when: You need a structured prep packet for a public meeting, town hall, or listening session.
output: An event brief with agenda, messages, ground rules, likely questions, and follow-up plan.

name: transit-service-change-brief
title: Transit Service Change Brief
use_when: The city or its transit provider is proposing a route, schedule, fare, or mobility service change and needs to brief decision-makers and inform riders.
output: A briefing with options, rider impact, cost, required process steps, and a rider-facing notice draft.

name: cip-review
title: Capital Improvement Plan Review
use_when: The city needs to review or re-rank capital projects.
output: A CIP review memo with ranking logic, recommended sequencing, funding notes, and deferral risks.

name: cybersecurity-posture-review
title: Cybersecurity Posture Review
use_when: Leadership needs a quarterly, non-technical view of the city's cybersecurity posture, incidents, training, vendor risk, and resource needs.
output: A leadership memo with risk summary, trend, control coverage, top three risks, and funded or unfunded actions, free of exploitable detail.

name: intergovernmental-relations-brief
title: Intergovernmental Relations Brief
use_when: The mayor or manager needs a concise regional/state/federal relationship brief.
output: A brief with partner status, current asks, sensitivities, and next engagement steps.

name: public-safety-review
title: Public Safety Quarterly Review
use_when: The city needs to assess quarterly performance across police, fire, EMS, and code enforcement — identifying trends, comparing to targets, surfacing resource concerns, and briefing leadership.
output: A quarterly public safety performance memo with department-by-department summaries, trend analysis, resource concerns, and recommended council discussion items.

name: risk-register-update
title: Risk Register Update
use_when: Leadership needs a practical refresh of operational, fiscal, legal, reputational, and safety risks.
output: An updated risk register with severity, trend, mitigation owners, and next actions.

name: strategic-priority-review
title: Strategic Priority Review
use_when: The city needs a quarterly scorecard on adopted goals or council priorities.
output: A strategic review with status, evidence, slippage reasons, and quarter-ahead focus.

name: workforce-planning-review
title: Workforce Planning Review
use_when: The city needs a quarterly view of vacancies, retention, succession, and training needs.
output: A workforce memo with pressure points, succession risks, and recommended actions.

name: city-manager-operations-review
title: City Manager Operations Review
use_when: The manager’s office needs a weekly operational review across departments.
output: An operations review memo with cross-department blockers, deadlines, and executive decisions needed.

name: community-engagement-summary
title: Community Engagement Summary
use_when: You need to summarize what the city heard from residents over the past week.
output: A theme-based summary with representative concerns, sentiment, and suggested follow-up.

name: council-weekly-brief
title: Council Weekly Brief
use_when: The governing body needs a weekly strategic and operational snapshot.
output: A weekly council brief with wins, watch items, decisions ahead, and questions for follow-up.

name: department-director-1on1
title: Department Director 1:1 Prep
use_when: You need an agenda and follow-up tracker for recurring manager/director check-ins.
output: A 1:1 agenda, key questions, decision points, and next-step tracker.

name: development-pipeline-review
title: Development Pipeline Review
use_when: Leadership wants a weekly picture of pending development activity and pressure points.
output: A pipeline memo summarizing near-term cases, constraints, and decisions likely to reach council.

name: interagency-coordination
title: Interagency Coordination
use_when: The city is working on a shared project or cross-jurisdictional issue with a county, regional authority, state agency, or special district and needs to align roles, communication, and deliverables.
output: A coordination summary with role-responsibility matrix, open issues list, proposed communication cadence, and draft talking points for the next interagency touchpoint.

name: legislative-monitor
title: Legislative Monitor
use_when: The city needs a running summary of state or regional legislation that could affect operations or authority.
output: A short weekly legislative memo with implications, recommended posture, and questions for advocacy.

name: project-status-dashboard-narrative
title: Project Status Dashboard Narrative
use_when: A dashboard needs human-readable narrative for leaders or the public.
output: Narrative summaries that explain status, changes, blockers, and what happens next.
